# Native consolidated field interface fixture

This export describes [source 66cc17a](https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-haskell/commit/66cc17ad58bc56d3c931ee2ff57652beb0a6ad4d),
replayed from original Haddock HTML and the compiled interface in the
[exact green workflow](https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-haskell/actions/runs/44482395043).
Archive digests and all 31 required source pages were checked before extraction.
The provenance records the separately committed producer.

The 17 public modules include one qualified Query.Fields facade in place of
the eight earlier field modules. Prefixes retain each row's meaning in pure
field and relationship tokens. Captured daemon metadata, native control
streams and canonical recovery imports remain source-bound. Earlier profile
fixtures remain unchanged.
